title: OpenFrontiers：开放研究问题集合与科学再发现基准
summary: OpenFrontiers汇集12,151个跨学科开放研究问题，并构建含200道数学题的回顾性基准（110道已解决、90道仍开放），每题附Lean 4形式化陈述。在HQ-50子集上评测七个LLM智能体，发现闭卷条件下成功再发现极少（40题中至多7题），联网成功多源于检索已发表解法。
summary_en: OpenFrontiers combines a corpus of 12,151 open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of 200 math problems (110 resolved, 90 open), each with a Lean 4 statement. Evaluating seven LLM agents on the HQ-50 subset, closed-book rediscovery is rare (at most 7 of 40), while live-web success mostly reflects retrieval of published solutions.
